targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-928 (superseding burned-id V3-EXQ-927; identical measurement) localised the MECH-267 mode-content wash-out at production num_cem_iterations=3 to the CEM refit breadth, not the elite-selection value function. Four arms x 30 shared seeds: H3 (mode_partitioned_cem) - OFF = +0.0167 paired, t=+4.34, 24/30 seeds positive; BOTH - OFF = +0.0142, t=+4.02; H2 (mode_value_weight) - OFF = +0.0015, t=+0.48, a clean null. Manipulation confirmed on 480/480 cells. The run's own acceptance gate (across-seed mean vs absolute FLOOR_PRODUCTION=0.01) is under-powered -- per-seed SD 0.011-0.018 exceeds the floor, giving t=+1.09 (H3) and t=+0.36 (BOTH) against it -- so the self-routed label `fix_effective::H3+BOTH` is correct on the paired vs-control contrast rather than on the gate it cleared. The indexer's `vacuous_pass` flag is adjudicated CLEARED as a criteria-tagging artifact: the declared combination rule is a disjunction ('>=1 fix arm clears') while all three per-arm criteria were tagged load_bearing:true; H2's sub-floor result is the informative half of the localisation, not a gate cleared on nothing. NARROWING: H3 restores the extreme-pair (broad-tight) breadth separation only -- the predicted monotone four-mode gradient is NOT restored in any arm (all adjacent gaps sub-floor; internal_replay->offline_consolidation inverts). Both facets default OFF (mode_partitioned_cem=False, mode_value_weight={}), so MECH-267 mode-conditioning remains washed out in production until the default flips. Diagnostic -- excluded from confidence and conflict scoring; pending_retest_after_substrate remains true, now gated on the default flip rather than on a build.

learning_extracted: A disjunctive (M-of-N) acceptance rule must not tag its per-member criteria load_bearing:true -- doing so makes the indexer's aggregation-vacuity rule (3b) fire on the very member whose failure is the informative result. Tag the AGGREGATE criterion load-bearing and the members not, as this driver already does correctly for its OFF control arm. Fix direction is the driver, never the indexer rule.

A PASS gate on an absolute floor is invalid when the per-seed SD exceeds the floor: here sd 0.011-0.018 against floor 0.010, giving t=+1.09 (H3) and t=+0.36 (BOTH) against the floor. Gates need an SD-of-delta term alongside the absolute floor (feedback_effect_size_pass_gate_margin).

A single-seed smoke must not calibrate a floor. The parent smoke read OFF ~2.1e-6; the 30-seed distribution is mean -0.0031 with sd 0.0113. Floor calibration needs a dispersion estimate, not a point estimate.

Prefer the paired same-seed contrast against the control arm as the GATED quantity when the design already shares seeds across arms. This design supported t=+4.34; only the choice of gated statistic wasted it.

A burned queue id re-run under a new id should stamp `supersedes` on the new manifest. Absent it the indexer double-counts one measurement -- here 927 + 928 both appear as diagnostic runs against MECH-267.
A no-op-default facet is not a delivered fix: validating H3 changes no production behaviour while mode_partitioned_cem defaults False (reference_claim_status_vs_default_off_flag).
Incidental positive control: a deterministic seeded probe re-executed 10 minutes later, across a substrate_hash change carrying no ree_core/ delta, reproduced every metric to the last decimal.
